sonnet.problem: This story card runs to about three sentences. The quoted verse already holds two sentences, and the card adds a third that restates it in Papa Dorin's words. It is longer than the 1 to 2 sentences allowed.
sonnet.rule: Every other story card, including the first card of a later stop, is 1 to 2 sentences.

sonnet.problem: The statement says Job asks whether his hope will go down 'with him' to the gates of Sheol and into the dust. The text only asks 'Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?'. It never says what 'it' is or who 'we' are. The card connects them for the baker.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: This card cites Job 16:12, but its question already gives the content of verse 13 ('God's archers surround him'). Story card 13 tells verse 13 only afterwards, so the choice card jumps ahead of the passage order.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
